name: lazy-browser-fixture
goal: Shared browser monitoring preserves API-only checks without a browser executable

evidence: The first implementation made an automatic fixture depend on context, adding a browser prerequisite to request-only tests.
The unchanged API-only test with /nonexistent/harness-browser failed because the automatic guard attempted Chromium launch.
Move context monitoring into the lazy context fixture and require an unavailable-browser API boundary check whenever shared fixture dependencies change.
The automatic collector now depends only on the browser-name option. The context fixture attaches monitoring when requested; root/generated guidance enforces the boundary review.
All 22 focused regressions passed, including real browser errors and API-only operation without a browser executable.
The built CLI generated an isolated app. Its API-only test passed, failed when the original eager context dependency was restored only in that fixture, then passed again after restoration: 0 / 1 / 0.
